تصطدموا (form VIII)
# تَصْطَدِمُوا (taṣṭadimū) /tasˤ.tˤa.di.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
# تُصْطَدَمُوا (tuṣṭadamū) /tusˤ.tˤa.da.muː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَدَمَ (iṣṭadama)
